limitations: These checks use public inputs. No private image, raw project, profile, local endpoint or service token is included.

DOM Save/export activation adds no synthetic pointer or focus event. Actual application/download focus changes are recorded separately; ordinary pointer activation can also blur and commit simple direct-edit fields.
Network-delay tests delay actual backend responses; an aborted network request is not proof of an uncooperative producer ignoring cancellation.
Raster dimensions and DPI metadata describe the exported grid, not newly recovered source detail. H&E input pixels are preserved; upscaling cannot restore image resolution.
A source runtime, frozen executable runtime and installed executable are distinct. The kind is explicit; installation identity requires separate installer and file-manifest verification.
